# Hierarchical Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Games

## 1. Number Placement Games
*(Fill cells with numbers according to constraints)*
- Sudoku
- Fillomino
- Ripple Effect
- Makaro
- Nansuke
- Hebi

## 2. Loop Drawing Games
*(Draw a single continuous closed loop through the grid)*
- Masyu
- Slitherlink
- Yajilin
- Dotchi-Loop
- Nagareru
- Moon-or-Sun
- Mid-loop
- Suraromu

## 3. Region Division Games
*(Partition the grid into defined areas or blocks)*
- Shikaku
- Five Cells
- Sashigane
- Double Choco
- Norinori
- LITS
- Nuritwin
- Chained Block
- Evolomino

## 4. Cell Shading Games
*(Determine which cells to paint black or color)*
- Nurikabe
- Heyawake
- Hitori
- Kurodoko
- Kurotto
- Usowan
- Choco Banana
- Tilepaint
- Sto-stone
- Shakashaka
- Nurimisaki
- Nurimeizu

## 5. Path and Connection Games
*(Connect elements or trace paths through the grid)*
- Hashiwokakero
- Numberlink
- Pencils
- Satogaeri
- Yosenabe

## 6. Symbol Placement Games
*(Place specific symbols or objects into grid cells)*
- Akari
- Juosan
- Norinori

## 7. Hybrid Constraint Games
*(Combine region, shading, and directional number constraints)*
- Juosan
- Norinori

---

> **Note:** Upon reflection, clean single-depth taxonomy requires resolving overlaps. Here is the corrected final version:

---

# Corrected Taxonomy

## 1. Number Placement
- Sudoku, Fillomino, Ripple Effect, Makaro, Nansuke, Hebi

## 2. Loop Drawing
- Masyu, Slitherlink, Yajilin, Dotchi-Loop, Nagareru, Moon-or-Sun, Mid-loop, Suraromu

## 3. Region Division
- Shikaku, Five Cells, Sashigane, Double Choco, LITS, Nuritwin, Chained Block, Evolomino

## 4. Cell Shading
- Nurikabe, Heyawake, Hitori, Kurodoko, Kurotto, Usowan, Choco Banana, Tilepaint, Sto-stone, Shakashaka, Nurimisaki, Nurimeizu

## 5. Path & Connection
- Hashiwokakero, Numberlink, Pencils, Satogaeri, Yosenabe

## 6. Symbol & Object Placement
- Akari, Norinori, Juosan

## 7. Movement & Flow
- (merged above)
